parameter_selection.selection_rule: Default Semble file order only. Keep development file Recall@10 within 0.01, Recall@100 within 0.02, and nDCG@10 within 0.03 absolute of baseline; maximize symbol nDCG@10, then symbol Recall@10 and Recall@100; break ties by fewer scored chunks. No held-out metric participates.

context_measures: 10 returned chunks; characters and whitespace-separated words (not model tokens)
